## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
The agent-skills repository hosts a curated set of reusable Agent Skills that follow the agentskills.io specification, enabling AI agents to perform a wide range of tasks. It includes dozens of ready‑to‑use skills such as TDD loops, brainstorming dialogs, project scaffolding, translation, and documentation generation, each packaged with clear metadata and language codes. The repository also defines naming conventions and installation methods via skillport or aider‑skills, making it easy to integrate and extend the skill set. Developers building AI‑driven workflows, educators, and hobbyists can benefit from these plug‑and‑play components, and they can get started by installing the package or browsing the README for usage examples.
